assets.name: toy-asphalt
assets.prompt_used: Style: printed children's play-rug / car play-mat illustration. Flat, bright, cheerful colors, slightly simplified cartoon shapes, clean 2-3 px dark grey outlines (#2B2B2B), no gradients except a soft drop shadow, no text, no logos, no brand names. Top-down map view, but buildings drawn in a slight front-facing 3/4 view (roof on top, front wall with windows and door visible), like on a toy car play-mat. Palette: grass #3EB34A, asphalt grey #9A9A9A, yellow edge lines #F2C230, white markings #FFFFFF, roofs red #D9342B / blue #2F6FD0 / yellow #F0B400 / grey #7A7F87, walls cream #F6E6B4, white, light blue #CFE6F5, salmon #F2B8A0, windows #4AA8E8. Original artwork only – do not copy any existing rug design. Seamless full-bleed asphalt texture with periodic edges. No padding: texture must cover map continuously.

Full-bleed seamless tiles have no padding. West round badges follow 90% diameter rather than generic 8% padding.
Non-square sprites have square 1024px masters with aspect ratio preserved.
Original geometry and original generated illustration, no prior conversation artwork reused.
